# Release Readiness Checklist

Use this checklist to confirm key stakeholders have completed their responsibilities before a release.

- [ ] Release scope documented and approved by Product Owner and Project Manager
- [ ] Business Analyst sign-off on acceptance criteria
- [ ] Development: All planned work merged and code reviewed
- [ ] QA Lead: Test execution completed, critical defects resolved
- [ ] QA Lead: Regression/SMOKE tests passed in staging
- [ ] DevOps: Deployment pipelines green and infrastructure provisioned
- [ ] DevOps: Rollback plan and runbooks available
- [ ] Security/Compliance checks completed (if applicable)
- [ ] Customer Success: Customer communications prepared
- [ ] Project Manager: Release approved and scheduled
- [ ] Post-release monitoring configured and owners assigned
- [ ] Stakeholder communication plan ready

Optional attachments:
- Links to test reports, deployment runbooks, and monitoring dashboards
